title: Cosmic Cash Sorcerer
description: A dramatic male sorcerer in an ornate purple and black coat stands on cracked stone, casting orange lightning from both hands. He is surrounded by a surreal cosmic scene featuring the Cash App logo, Bitcoin sign, Varo Bank and Varo Believe branding, glowing smartphones emitting dollar signs, ghostly blue figures, a large mystical eye in the sky, galaxies, and a futuristic cityscape.
